subject: CAIQ intake: Marketplace integration — evidence & mapping
messages:
From: Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@cloudmarketplace.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.p@acme.io>
Date: 2028-03-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ intake: Marketplace integration — evidence & mapping

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. As the next step for the CloudMarket marketplace onboarding we need a CAIQ mapping and an evidence index covering the controls we flagged in the intake scan (attached). Specifically we need:

- A CAIQ response workbook with your answer per control (accept/partial/NA) and a short rationale.
- An evidence manifest that maps each control to concrete artifacts (log samples, runbooks, diagrams, screenshots, certs).
- Owner assignments for each control so we can route verification to our auditor.

Deadline: we need the first pass by Tue 27 Mar so our security ops team can kick off the review on 28 Mar. Can you confirm who will own: tenant isolation, key management, and runtime telemetry?

Files: I attached Marketplace_CAIQ_v4.xlsx (your intake list). Please upload artifacts to the shared Drive folder below or send a zipped package.

Marketplace Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cMarketplaceEvidence

Thanks,
Sam Ortega
Security Integration Lead
CloudMarket

Attachment: Marketplace_CAIQ_v4.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@cloudmarketplace.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-03-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake: Marketplace integration — evidence & mapping

Sam — thanks for the clear ask and the intake file. We'll own this and split into an evidence sprint. High-level plan below:

1) Deliverable: CAIQ response tracker (tabbed by domain) with column: control id, answer, rationale, evidence pointer, owner, ETA. (I attached a starter tracker.)
2) Evidence staging: we will upload a zipped evidence_manifest with named artifacts (logs, diagrams, certs) to your Drive by the 27 Mar target.
3) Owners: Jordan will take tenant/segregation and entitlement proofs; Kimberly will take key management, KMS/HSM attestations, and encryption at rest; I'll coordinate runtime telemetry and operational evidence (traces, sampling plans).

Immediate asks for you: please confirm if the auditor requires redacted run-level logs or full sample sets. Also share any template file names/naming convention you prefer in the Drive folder so our uploads line up with your scans.

I pasted the owner roster below for clarity:
- Jordan Blake — Tenant isolation, VPC & routing, access gating artifacts
- Kimberly Park — KMS/HSM, key rotation proof, encryption at rest
- Irene Choi — Runtime telemetry, sampling logs, SLA tracers, and the CAIQ narrative

We will attach: CAIQ_response_tracker.xlsx (draft), dataflow_diagram_v2.pdf, system_arch_diagram.pdf. Expect the draft CAIQ response + manifest by 2028-03-26 EOD for internal review; final upload to your Drive on 2028-03-27 morning.

Irene Choi
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CAIQ_response_tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet), dataflow_diagram_v2.pdf, system_arch_diagram.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@cloudmarketplace.com>
Date: 2028-03-20T12:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake: Marketplace integration — evidence & mapping

Irene — I'll take tenant isolation and entitlement proofs. Quick note from my side: the most concise evidence for the auditor will be:
- Network segmentation matrix (which tenants map to which VPCs/subnets)
- Sample routing ACLs and an exported IAM policy snapshot (with timestamps)
- A small set of anonymized trace logs showing tenant tagging across the request path (3-5 traces)

I've attached dataflow_diagram_v2.pdf which shows current tenant boundaries and where we drop tenant ids into headers. I'll own uploading the ACL snippets and the IAM snapshots to the Drive.

Jordan
Product Security Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: dataflow_diagram_v2.pdf
From: Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@cloudmarketplace.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Patel <maya.p@acme.io>
Date: 2028-03-21T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake: Marketplace integration — evidence & mapping

Irene / team — helpful plan, thanks. A couple of clarifications from the auditor side:

- For encryption at rest we need the KMS key policy snapshot plus the most recent rotation timestamp and a redacted HSM attestation if available.
- For runtime telemetry, the auditor prefers a 24-hour sample of token-level traces AND the sampling policy that produced them (we can accept redacted tokens).
- Logs: redacted is fine but please include the mapping that explains how you removed PII (scrub rules).

Drive upload: upload into the folder and please use the prefix CMKT_YYYYMMDD_ for each artifact so our ingestion script can attach them to the correct control rows.

Also, FYI we have a short internal pre-check on 2028-03-28 10:00 AM PDT where the auditor will spot-check the manifest. If your final upload is 03-27 morning as discussed, we should be OK.

Thanks,
Sam

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@cloudmarketplace.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake: Marketplace integration — evidence & mapping

Sam — good questions. Final confirmation and upload plan below:

1) Naming convention: CMKT_20280327_<artifact_shortname> (we will follow exactly).
2) What we'll upload (per your format):
   - CMKT_20280327_CAIQ_responses.xlsx (final tracker, control-level answers & rationales)
   - CMKT_20280327_Evidence_manifest.zip (zipped artifacts with manifest.json inside describing redaction rules)
   - CMKT_20280327_KMS_snapshot.json (key policy export) and CMKT_20280327_HSM_attestation.pdf (redacted)
   - CMKT_20280327_Telemetry_sample_24h.log (redacted) and CMKT_20280327_Sampling_policy.md
   - CMKT_20280327_Dataflow_diagram.pdf (Jordan) and CMKT_20280327_ACL_snippets.txt (Jordan)

3) Upload cadence: Jordan will push his items by 03-26 18:00 PDT; Kimberly will upload KMS/HSM artifacts 03-27 08:00 PDT; I will finalize telemetry sample + CAIQ_responses 03-27 09:00 PDT. Full manifest zip will be in Drive by 03-27 10:00 PDT.

4) Evidence redaction: we'll include a README describing scrub rules and an audit log showing who redacted what and when.

If anything blocks this timeline please call me directly (415-555-0192). Otherwise we'll proceed to upload and I'll ping once the Drive has the final zip.

Thanks — Irene

Attachments (to be uploaded as part of final package): evidence_manifest.zip, CAIQ_response_tracker.xlsx, dataflow_diagram_v2.pdf, system_arch_diagram.pdf
